## What we learned

- **Name Tag V1:** a design has to communicate its purpose clearly.
- **About Me / Past, Present & Becoming:** identity can be communicated through selected experiences, interests, communities, skills, and goals.
- **Listening notes:** learning about another person takes attention, not only speaking.
- **Technical description:** communication is part of technological work.
- **Machine Charades:** movement and teamwork can communicate a machine or process.
- These activities created a bridge from **personal identity** toward **group and visual identity**.
